Overview & City Profile

Echallens (Echallens (BFS 5518)) is a municipality in Gros-de-Vaud District, Canton of Vaud (coordinates 46.6384°N, 6.6353°E; population 5,726). Visitors use Echallens as a base to explore Canton of Vaud's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Papet Vaudois, Filets de perche du Léman, Malakoff fried cheese.

Within Canton of Vaud Region (Gros-de-Vaud District region), Echallens (Echallens (BFS 5518)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in canton of vaud region. Travelers exploring Canton of Vaud often combine a stop in Echallens with regional highlights such as Château de Chillon & Montreux Riviera, Lavaux UNESCO Vineyard Terraces, Lausanne Olympic Museum & Cathedral, Glacier 3000 & Villars-sur-Ollon.

Getting to Echallens & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Lausanne Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): 40 minutes from Geneva Airport along the Lake Geneva SBB mainline via Lausanne, Vevey and Montreux.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Canton of Vaud Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Lausanne with Echallens. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Canton of Vaud have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Echallens en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Echallens are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Canton of Vaud can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Switzerland Guide.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Canton of Vaud: May–Oct.

Regional highlights across Canton of Vaud Region that pair well with a visit to Echallens include: Château de Chillon & Montreux Riviera, Lavaux UNESCO Vineyard Terraces, Lausanne Olympic Museum & Cathedral, Glacier 3000 & Villars-sur-Ollon.

Practical Travel Tips for Echallens

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Echallens (or at Lausanne Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Echallens accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Echallens (Echallens (BFS 5518)) located in Switzerland?

Echallens (Echallens (BFS 5518)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Canton of Vaud Region in the Gros-de-Vaud District region of Switzerland (coordinates: 46.6384°N, 6.6353°E). It has a population of approximately 5,726 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Echallens by train?

Most visitors reach Echallens via the main prefectural gateway of Lausanne Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). 40 minutes from Geneva Airport along the Lake Geneva SBB mainline via Lausanne, Vevey and Montreux. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Echallens. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Echallens and Canton of Vaud known for?

In Echallens and across Canton of Vaud Region, top local dishes include Papet Vaudois, Filets de perche du Léman, Malakoff fried cheese, as well as Lavaux Chasselas wines and Gruyère & Etivaz alpine cheeses. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Echallens?

Best time to visit Canton of Vaud: May–Oct. Check our Switzerland Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
